85K likes, 1,146 comments - beyounick on April 8, 2026: "In 2016 the most common comment on my videos was "you are the most underrated YouTuber in India." It's 2026. I still get it.

I used to not know how to feel about that. Now I do. Because the people who said it  kept showing up. Every single year. And that's not underrated. That's everything.

Couldn't ask for more. Genuinely blessed.

Watch the teaser. Share it if it hits. Comment if you feel it. That's the only currency we have right now and it means everything. ❤️

#UnknownGunman #beyounick".

posts.meta_description:
61K likes, 111 comments - beyounick on September 29, 2026: "Back when social media was still new and nobody really knew how brands and creators were supposed to collaborate, I genuinely think some of the best branded content was made.
I remember working with @ashutoshvalani and @jacobprix for Beardo. There were barely any briefs. We were just making videos we thought were funny, and somehow the brand fit naturally into them.
Today, with brands and agencies having a million briefs about what to say, what not to say, when the product should appear, how many seconds it should be visible for… somewhere along the way, I feel like we lost a little bit of that magic.
And that’s why this short film is special to me.
I wrote it. I shot it. And only after that did I go to the brand because I genuinely felt they fit perfectly into the story.
No reverse engineering an idea around a brief. No ticking boxes. Just making something I wanted to make and finding the right partner for it.
Thank you Shiladitya & Rohit for being spontaneous enough to say yes and trusting the idea.
This is probably my favourite piece of work I’ve done in the last few years.
Not because it was the biggest.
But because, for a little while, it made me feel like I was back where I started  just making something because I thought it would be fun to make.".
